_comment: Worst-case scenario for the per-soldier multi-target melee widening (#1092): four large friendly regiments, each simultaneously adjacent to four distinct enemy regiments (a tight 2x2 cluster per side), so SoldierMelee.resolve's nearest-search runs against the widest realistic candidate population (4 adjacent engaged units) for every attacking soldier, every cadence tick -- not the typical 1-2 this repo's combat scenarios exercise elsewhere. Loaded directly by BenchmarkRunner.gd via Battle.scenario, like large-battle.json.
